detail: Body text must have a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the background. Large text (>= 24px regular or >= 18.6px bold) must maintain at least 3:1.
check: Always test muted grays (#949494, #aaaaaa) and brand accents (#ff630f) against #000000 backgrounds.

detail: Interactive elements must provide an accessible hit area of at least 44px × 44px on touch and mobile devices.
check: Ensure buttons, icon toggles, and disclosure triggers meet 44px minimum bounding box or padding.

detail: When an overlay or dialog is active, focus must be trapped inside the modal, body scroll locked, and underlying content marked with the HTML inert attribute.
check: Ensure Escape key closes modal and returns focus to the trigger element.

detail: Honor the user's OS-level motion preference by disabling non-essential keyframe animations and transform transitions.
check: Wrap all looping, bouncing, or parallax movements in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

detail: Off-screen below-the-fold sections should use content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size to skip initial layout and rendering cost.
check: Verify all long-scroll sections have explicit contain-intrinsic-size heights to prevent scrollbar jumps.
